limits: Fake optimizer and synthetic rewards; no model contacted. Implemented from the paper's description; no GEPA or DSPy code. The pre-call scan and sandboxed host are evidenced by procedure_006.
outcome: passed: The Pareto front over per-prompt D4 scores keeps exactly the non-dominated candidates (a dominated candidate and an equal score vector are excluded) and parent sampling follows the number of prompts each front member scores best on (0.75 observed for 3 of 4 prompts); a child whose minibatch score beats its parent's is accepted, fully evaluated (60 rollouts) and replaces the dominated seed on the front, while children that do not improve are recorded with a minibatch score only and never fully evaluated; with the preregistered settings a run costs 3 minibatches of 10 plus one full evaluation, and a second accepted child whose full evaluation would exceed 120 rollouts is not evaluated (unit-cap); the reflection input holds only the parent text and the parent's minibatch vectors; the same seed repeats parent and minibatch choices; an unusable reflection is a failed call. Negative control: an optimizer outside the runner channel is refused (optimizer-bypass).
